LanguageData.LP_CS_Thaumaturgy.label: thaumaturgy
LanguageData.LP_CS_Thaumaturgy.description: Cantrip (Transmutation): manifest a minor wonder at a point within 15 cells: filth in radius 2 is cleaned up and a holy light burns for 1 hour. Cooldown 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_TollTheDead.label: toll the dead
LanguageData.LP_CS_TollTheDead.description: Cantrip (Necromancy): a death knell tolls in the ear of one enemy within 24 cells, dealing 8 × power necrotic damage; double damage if the target is already hurt. Cooldown 4 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Resistance.label: resistance
LanguageData.LP_CS_Resistance.description: Cantrip (Abjuration): one ally within 10 cells takes ×0.85 damage for 30 seconds. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_HealingWord.label: healing word
LanguageData.LP_CS_HealingWord.description: Circle 1 (Evocation, upcastable): speak a healing word from afar: one ally within 30 cells instantly heals 10 × power injury (bleeding wounds first). Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Command.label: command
LanguageData.LP_CS_Command.description: Circle 1 (Enchantment, upcastable): give one enemy within 20 cells a one-word command, 60% success: randomly "Grovel" (downed for 3 seconds), "Flee" (runs away) or "Drop" (drops its weapon). -5% per level the target is above the caster (minimum 10%), halved against legendary creatures and story bosses, and mind resistance also resists it. No effect on mechanoids. Upcast: command one more enemy within 6 cells per circle. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ShieldOfFaith.label: shield of faith
LanguageData.LP_CS_ShieldOfFaith.description: Circle 1 (Abjuration, concentration): one ally within 20 cells is surrounded by a shimmering shield for 10 minutes: sharp and blunt armor +20% (concentration). Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_CreateWater.label: create water
LanguageData.LP_CS_CreateWater.description: Circle 1 (Conjuration, ritual): a shower of clean water falls in radius 3 within 20 cells: puts out fires in the area (including people on fire) and waters crops (+5% growth). Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_PurifyFood.label: purify food and drink
LanguageData.LP_CS_PurifyFood.description: Circle 1 (Transmutation, ritual): purify food in radius 3 within 10 cells: rot progress reset to zero; friendly people in range are cured of food poisoning. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_GuidingBolt.label: guiding bolt
LanguageData.LP_CS_GuidingBolt.description: Circle 1 (Evocation, upcastable): a bolt of light flies at one enemy within 24 cells, 14 × power radiant damage; for 10 seconds afterwards, the next attack on it deals ×1.3 damage. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 15 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Aid.label: aid
LanguageData.LP_CS_Aid.description: Circle 2 (Abjuration, upcastable): one ally within 20 cells and 2 other allies within 6 cells of it each gain 10 × power temporary hit points (temp HP is lost before taking damage), lasting 8 hours. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpiritualWeapon.label: spiritual weapon
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpiritualWeapon.description: Circle 2 (Evocation, concentration): summon a floating radiant hammer; for 1 minute it strikes the nearest enemy within 15 cells of the caster every 2 seconds for 8 × power damage (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_PrayerOfHealing.label: prayer of healing
LanguageData.LP_CS_PrayerOfHealing.description: Circle 2 (Evocation, ritual): lead up to 10 allies within 8 cells in prayer: each heals 25 × power injury. Can be cast as a ritual (channel in place for 1 hour, no resources spent). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Silence.label: silence
LanguageData.LP_CS_Silence.description: Circle 2 (Illusion, ritual, concentration): an area of radius 3 within 20 cells falls utterly silent for 1 minute: nobody inside can speak incantations or cast class spells (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Revivify.label: revivify
LanguageData.LP_CS_Revivify.description: Circle 3 (Necromancy): revive a humanlike corpse within 5 cells that has been dead no more than 1 day; the revived gets 3 days of "resurrection sickness". No effect on liches, necromantic constructs or corpses without a brain. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpiritGuardians.label: spirit guardians
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpiritGuardians.description: Circle 3 (Conjuration, concentration): guardian spirits whirl around you for 1 minute: every second they deal 4 × power radiant damage to enemies within 3 cells and make them move ×0.5 (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_CreateFood.label: create food
LanguageData.LP_CS_CreateFood.description: Circle 3 (Conjuration, ritual): conjure 15 simple meals next to the caster. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MassHealingWord.label: mass healing word
LanguageData.LP_CS_MassHealingWord.description: Circle 3 (Evocation, upcastable): up to 6 of the most injured allies within 20 cells each heal 10 × power injury. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Daylight.label: daylight
LanguageData.LP_CS_Daylight.description: Circle 3 (Evocation): three bright orbs of light rise at a point within 30 cells, lighting a large area for 1 day. Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_RemoveCurse.label: remove curse
LanguageData.LP_CS_RemoveCurse.description: Circle 3 (Abjuration): remove curse-type conditions from an ally within 5 cells (hexes, all curses, divine domination), as well as the curse on one cursed item they have equipped. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_FreedomOfMovement.label: freedom of movement
LanguageData.LP_CS_FreedomOfMovement.description: Circle 4 (Abjuration): one ally within 10 cells is unaffected by slows, restraints and stuns for 1 hour (cleared once per second). Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_GuardianOfFaith.label: guardian of faith
LanguageData.LP_CS_GuardianOfFaith.description: Circle 4 (Conjuration): conjure a radiant guardian (radius 2.5) at a point within 20 cells: enemies that come near take 20 × power radiant damage (once per enemy every 5 seconds); it vanishes after 4 hits or 8 hours. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Divination.label: divination
LanguageData.LP_CS_Divination.description: Circle 4 (Divination, ritual): ask the gods: lists the threat events already scheduled within 3 days and estimates the size of one raid. Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_FlameStrike.label: flame strike
LanguageData.LP_CS_FlameStrike.description: Circle 5 (Evocation, upcastable): a column of fire falls from the sky: enemies in radius 2.5 within 24 cells take 18 × power fire damage and 18 × power radiant damage. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_GreaterRestoration.label: greater restoration
LanguageData.LP_CS_GreaterRestoration.description: Circle 5 (Abjuration): remove one stubborn ailment from an ally within 5 cells: feeblemind, hexes and curses, old brain injuries, dementia, Alzheimer's, cataracts, hearing loss, frailty, bad back, asthma, or the worst old scar. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_RaiseDead.label: raise dead
LanguageData.LP_CS_RaiseDead.description: Circle 5 (Necromancy): revive a humanlike corpse within 5 cells that has been dead no more than 10 days; the revived gets 3 days of "resurrection sickness". No effect on liches, necromantic constructs or corpses without a brain. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Hallow.label: hallow
LanguageData.LP_CS_Hallow.description: Circle 5 (Evocation, ritual): consecrate an area of radius 6 within 10 cells for 10 days: undead, demons, devils and anomalous creatures that enter take 10 × power radiant damage per second and are pushed out. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_BladeBarrier.label: blade barrier
LanguageData.LP_CS_BladeBarrier.description: Circle 6 (Evocation, concentration): raise a 10-cell-long wall of whirling blades within 24 cells for 1 minute: enemies standing on the wall take 15 × power cut damage per second (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_HeroesFeast.label: heroes' feast
LanguageData.LP_CS_HeroesFeast.description: Circle 6 (Conjuration, ritual): lay out a god-given feast: up to 12 friendly humanlikes within 8 cells are fed, cured of food poisoning and toxins, and for 24 hours get toxic resistance +100%, mental break threshold -15%, and 20 × power temporary hit points. Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Heal.label: heal
LanguageData.LP_CS_Heal.description: Circle 6 (Evocation): one ally within 20 cells heals 70 × power injury and is cured of disease, blindness, food poisoning and toxins. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureCelestial.label: conjure celestial
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureCelestial.description: Circle 7 (Conjuration, concentration): summon a deva to fight for the caster for 1 hour (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Resurrection.label: resurrection
LanguageData.LP_CS_Resurrection.description: Circle 7 (Necromancy): revive a humanlike corpse within 5 cells no matter how long it has been dead (as long as the corpse still exists), with all injuries and missing parts restored. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_DivineWord.label: divine word
LanguageData.LP_CS_DivineWord.description: Circle 7 (Evocation): speak a true name of the divine: enemies within 8 cells are stunned for 4 seconds and blinded for 10 seconds (those with over half their health lost: stunned 10 seconds, blinded 30 seconds); outsiders (demons, devils, elementals, fey) have a 60% chance to be banished straight back to their home plane (except story bosses). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_HolyAura.label: holy aura
LanguageData.LP_CS_HolyAura.description: Circle 8 (Abjuration, concentration): the caster and up to 9 allies within 6 cells are bathed in holy light for 1 minute: damage taken ×0.7 (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_DivineColumn.label: pillar of divine punishment
LanguageData.LP_CS_DivineColumn.description: Circle 8 (Evocation): a pillar of light falls from the sky: enemies in radius 3 within 30 cells take 45 × power radiant damage and are stunned for 2 seconds. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MassHeal9.label: mass heal
LanguageData.LP_CS_MassHeal9.description: Circle 9 (Evocation): up to 12 of the most injured allies within 15 cells each heal 60 × power injury and are cured of disease, blindness and toxins. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_TrueResurrection.label: true resurrection
LanguageData.LP_CS_TrueResurrection.description: Circle 9 (Necromancy): revive a dead colonist, no corpse needed, with all injuries and missing parts restored, waking up next to the caster. Once every 7 days. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Druidcraft.label: druidcraft
LanguageData.LP_CS_Druidcraft.description: Cantrip (Transmutation): read the sky: reports how long the current weather will last, roughly the temperature over the next day and any ongoing weather events; plants within 2 cells grow a little faster. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Shillelagh.label: shillelagh
LanguageData.LP_CS_Shillelagh.description: Cantrip (Transmutation): infuse the club or fist in hand with nature's power, melee damage ×1.4 for 1 minute. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ProduceFlame.label: produce flame
LanguageData.LP_CS_ProduceFlame.description: Cantrip (Conjuration): flame flares up in your palm and is hurled at one enemy within 20 cells, 8 × power fire damage. Cooldown 4 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ThornWhip.label: thorn whip
LanguageData.LP_CS_ThornWhip.description: Cantrip (Transmutation): a thorny whip lashes one enemy within 12 cells for 7 × power cut damage and pulls it up to 3 cells toward the caster. Cooldown 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MoldEarth.label: mold earth
LanguageData.LP_CS_MoldEarth.description: Cantrip (Transmutation): one cell within 10 cells: rock is dug out at once; shallow water, mud and marsh are filled into soil; otherwise the floor is cleaned. Cooldown 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Goodberry.label: goodberry
LanguageData.LP_CS_Goodberry.description: Circle 1 (Transmutation): conjure 10 goodberries (wither after 15 days): each is as nourishing as a meal and heals 5 points of injury over 5 seconds when eaten. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Jump.label: jump
LanguageData.LP_CS_Jump.description: Circle 1 (Transmutation): one ally within 10 cells runs and leaps as if flying for 1 hour: movement ×1.3. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Moonbeam.label: moonbeam
LanguageData.LP_CS_Moonbeam.description: Circle 2 (Evocation, concentration): a silver beam of moonlight of radius 1.5 falls at a point within 24 cells for 1 minute: enemies inside take 10 × power radiant damage per second (concentration). The beam does not move. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpikeGrowth.label: spike growth
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpikeGrowth.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation, concentration): the ground in radius 3 within 24 cells sprouts spikes for 1 minute: enemies inside move ×0.5 and take 4 × power cut damage per second (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_FlamingSphere.label: flaming sphere
LanguageData.LP_CS_FlamingSphere.description: Circle 2 (Conjuration, concentration): conjure a scorching ball of fire (radius 1.5) at a point within 20 cells; for 1 minute it deals 8 × power fire damage per second to enemies inside (concentration). The sphere does not move. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_FindTraps.label: find traps
LanguageData.LP_CS_FindTraps.description: Circle 2 (Divination): detect hostile traps on the map and reveal invisible enemies within 40 cells; a letter lists their positions. Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_AnimalMessenger.label: animal messenger
LanguageData.LP_CS_AnimalMessenger.description: Circle 2 (Enchantment, ritual): send a small animal with a message to a faction's leader, opening a call with them (like a comms console). Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_WindWall.label: wind wall
LanguageData.LP_CS_WindWall.description: Circle 3 (Evocation, concentration): raise an 8-cell-long wall of gale within 20 cells for 1 minute: enemies on the wall are blown back 2 cells and take 6 × power blunt damage (once per second); allies within 1 cell of the wall take half ranged damage (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_StoneShape.label: stone shape
LanguageData.LP_CS_StoneShape.description: Circle 4 (Transmutation): one cell within 15 cells: rock is carved out at once (dropping stone chunks); on open ground a stone wall rises. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureWoodland.label: conjure woodland beings
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureWoodland.description: Circle 4 (Conjuration, concentration): summon 2 woodland beings (dryads, or satyrs if none) to fight for the caster for 1 hour (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_DominateBeast.label: dominate beast
LanguageData.LP_CS_DominateBeast.description: Circle 4 (Enchantment, concentration): one hostile animal within 20 cells (manhunting, or brought by enemies) has a 50% chance to be dominated and obeys the caster for 1 minute (concentration). Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_InsectPlague.label: insect plague
LanguageData.LP_CS_InsectPlague.description: Circle 5 (Conjuration, concentration): a swarm of locusts pours out in radius 4 within 24 cells for 1 minute: enemies inside take 5 × power cut damage per second and move ×0.5 (concentration). Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_TreeStride.label: tree stride
LanguageData.LP_CS_TreeStride.description: Circle 5 (Conjuration): while standing by a tree (within 2 cells), step into it and come out by another tree on the map (the destination must have a tree within 1 cell and be explored). Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Awaken.label: awaken
LanguageData.LP_CS_Awaken.description: Circle 5 (Transmutation, ritual): awaken the mind of a tamed animal within 5 cells: it learns every training it can, and never forgets any of it again (no reverting to wild). Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Reincarnate.label: reincarnate
LanguageData.LP_CS_Reincarnate.description: Circle 5 (Transmutation): revive a humanlike corpse within 5 cells that has been dead no more than 10 days in a new body: all injuries and missing parts restored, but the race changes randomly to another (elf, dwarf, half-orc, genasi, tiefling..., requires Biotech). Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ControlEnvironment.label: control weather
LanguageData.LP_CS_ControlEnvironment.description: Circle 5 (Transmutation): end one bad weather event on the map (cold snap, heat wave, toxic fallout, volcanic winter...) and clear the weather. Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_WindWalk.label: wind walk
LanguageData.LP_CS_WindWalk.description: Circle 6 (Transmutation): the caster and up to 9 allies within 8 cells turn into wind for 1 hour: movement ×2. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Whirlwind.label: whirlwind
LanguageData.LP_CS_Whirlwind.description: Circle 7 (Evocation): call a tornado at a point within 30 cells that dissipates after 30 seconds (it wanders on its own and doesn't care who is friend or foe). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Earthquake.label: earthquake
LanguageData.LP_CS_Earthquake.description: Circle 8 (Evocation): the earth shakes in radius 6 within 30 cells: enemies take 20 × power blunt damage and are stunned for 2 seconds, and buildings in range not belonging to the caster's side take 40 × power damage. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_AnimalShapes.label: animal shapes
LanguageData.LP_CS_AnimalShapes.description: Circle 8 (Transmutation): the caster and up to 9 allies within 8 cells turn into beasts for 1 hour (as Wild Shape). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_StormOfVengeance.label: storm of vengeance
LanguageData.LP_CS_StormOfVengeance.description: Circle 9 (Conjuration, concentration): storm clouds gather over radius 10 within 40 cells for 1 minute: every 2 seconds a 25 × power lightning bolt strikes an enemy in the area (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_TreeOfLife.label: tree of life
LanguageData.LP_CS_TreeOfLife.description: Circle 9 (Transmutation): plant a glowing tree of life (radius 6) within 15 cells: for 1 day, allies inside heal 3 × power injury per second. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MindSliver.label: mind sliver
LanguageData.LP_CS_MindSliver.description: Cantrip (Enchantment): an invisible psychic spike stabs into the mind of one enemy within 24 cells: 7 × power psychic damage (ignores armor), and sight -20% for 10 seconds (both shooting and melee worsen). Cooldown 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MetaPierce.label: metamagic: heightened
LanguageData.LP_CS_MetaPierce.description: Circle 1 (Metamagic): gained at sorcerer level 3: the next spell cast within 30 seconds gets +25% control success (used up once cast). Cooldown 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_DragonsBreath.label: dragon's breath
LanguageData.LP_CS_DragonsBreath.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation, upcastable): breathe a 6-cell cone of dragon breath; enemies inside take 16 × power damage; the element depends on the bloodline (ice / water → cold, wind / storm → lightning, black → acid, green → poison, others → fire). Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MetaExtend.label: metamagic: extended
LanguageData.LP_CS_MetaExtend.description: Circle 2 (Metamagic): gained at sorcerer level 5: the next spell cast within 30 seconds has duration ×2 (used up once cast). Cooldown 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MetaQuicken.label: metamagic: quickened
LanguageData.LP_CS_MetaQuicken.description: Circle 3 (Metamagic): gained at sorcerer level 9: the next spell cast within 30 seconds triggers no cooldown (used up once cast). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_BloodlineBreath.label: bloodline breath
LanguageData.LP_CS_BloodlineBreath.description: Circle 6 (Transmutation): pour out a 10-cell cone of bloodline dragon breath; enemies inside take 45 × power damage; the element depends on the bloodline (as Dragon's Breath). Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_PsychicBlast.label: psychic scream
LanguageData.LP_CS_PsychicBlast.description: Circle 7 (Enchantment): enemies in radius 3 within 24 cells take 35 × power psychic damage (ignores armor) and are stunned for 2 seconds. Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ElementalStorm.label: elemental storm
LanguageData.LP_CS_ElementalStorm.description: Circle 8 (Evocation, concentration): whip up a storm of fire, ice and lightning in radius 5 within 30 cells for 30 seconds: enemies inside take 12 × power random elemental damage per second (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_BloodlineAwakening.label: bloodline awakening
LanguageData.LP_CS_BloodlineAwakening.description: Circle 9 (Transmutation): the bloodline fully awakens for 1 minute: damage and healing of all class spells and abilities ×1.5. Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ChillTouch.label: chill touch
LanguageData.LP_CS_ChillTouch.description: Cantrip (Necromancy): a ghostly hand grabs one enemy within 24 cells: 8 × power necrotic damage, and its wounds cannot heal for 10 seconds. Cooldown 4 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MinorIllusion.label: minor illusion
LanguageData.LP_CS_MinorIllusion.description: Cantrip (Illusion): conjure a lifelike illusion at a point within 24 cells: enemies within radius 4 are distracted, sight -15% for 10 seconds. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_HellishRebuke.label: hellish rebuke
LanguageData.LP_CS_HellishRebuke.description: Circle 1 (Evocation): within 1 hour, the next time an enemy wounds you, hellfire instantly burns them back for 15 × power fire damage (then fades). Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ArmsOfHadar.label: arms of Hadar
LanguageData.LP_CS_ArmsOfHadar.description: Circle 1 (Conjuration, upcastable): dark tentacles surge out around you: enemies within 2.5 cells take 12 × power cold damage and freeze for 1 second. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 15 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpiderClimb.label: spider climb
LanguageData.LP_CS_SpiderClimb.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation): one ally within 10 cells crawls like a spider for 1 hour: no slowdown from terrain, snow or plants, movement ×1.1. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_HungerOfHadar.label: hunger of Hadar
LanguageData.LP_CS_HungerOfHadar.description: Circle 3 (Conjuration, concentration): tear open a rift to the void in radius 3 within 24 cells for 1 minute: inside is pitch dark (ranged accuracy drops sharply), and enemies take 6 × power cold and 3 × power acid damage per second (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ContactOtherPlane.label: contact other plane
LanguageData.LP_CS_ContactOtherPlane.description: Circle 5 (Divination, ritual): seek knowledge from otherworldly beings, success chance 55% + Intelligence modifier × 5% + (power - 1) × 20%: on success, lists the threat events already scheduled within 3 days and grants 500 × power research progress; on failure, you go insane and wander for a while. Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Dream.label: dream
LanguageData.LP_CS_Dream.description: Circle 5 (Illusion, ritual): slip into the dream of a friendly person on the map: their mood +8 (1 day). Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Eyebite.label: eyebite
LanguageData.LP_CS_Eyebite.description: Circle 6 (Necromancy, concentration): your eyes become voids for 1 minute: every 3 seconds, stare at the nearest enemy within 12 cells with a 50% chance to put it to sleep for 10 seconds, make it panic and flee, or weaken it for 30 seconds (melee damage ×0.5) (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SummonFiend.label: summon fiend
LanguageData.LP_CS_SummonFiend.description: Circle 6 (Conjuration, concentration): summon a chain devil from the Nine Hells to fight for the caster for 1 hour (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_PowerWordStun.label: power word stun
LanguageData.LP_CS_PowerWordStun.description: Circle 8 (Enchantment): speak a word of stunning to one enemy within 24 cells: enemies who have lost over half their health (health ≤ 60%) are stunned for 8 seconds; those barely hurt are unaffected. Cooldown 1 minute.
